name: start QB replacement
hypothesis: A starting-QB withdrawal is under-priced once the backup is confirmed, because the market adjusts on the news wire before the report is official
trigger_rule: Club's report or IR move removes the QB1 and the next QB on the depth chart has < 200 career pass attempts
correlation_note: highly correlated with the game total and every pass-volume prop in the same game

name: practice trajectory
hypothesis: Trend beats tag: DNP-DNP-FP is a different event from FP-FP-DNP even when Friday's tag is identical
trigger_rule: Trajectory over the club's three filings (Wed/Thu/Fri for a Sunday game - see F-08)
inputs_required: practice_status history for the same player across 3 filings
correlation_note: weak cross-game correlation; same-game legs stack

name: offensive line depletion
hypothesis: Two or more report-status starters missing from the O-line moves sack rate and short-yardage efficiency more than the total
trigger_rule: count(game_status=Out on positions T/G/C) >= 2 for the same side of the ball
correlation_note: correlated with SIG-04 and with the opposing edge-rusher props

name: edge rusher absence
hypothesis: Losing a primary pass-rush generator raises the opponent's dropback count and clean-time, so passing-volume overs are under-priced
trigger_rule: count(Out among DE/LB on the first defense) >= 1 with > 6.0% pressure share (share itself unverified: no official pressure feed in repo)
market: opponent QB passing attempts / passing yards
correlation_note: positive correlation with the game total over (same side of the field)

name: secondary depletion
hypothesis: Two or more DBs out (or on concussion protocol) raises target share for the opponent's WR1 more than it raises the total
trigger_rule: count(Out among CB/S) >= 2 on the same defense
correlation_note: correlated with the same-game pass attempts and completions

name: WR1 out - volume redistribution
hypothesis: A top-target receiver's absence redistributes targets to the same backfield and TE, so the team total drops but the second-option volume prop does not
trigger_rule: count(Out on WR with > 18% target share) >= 1 (target share not available - Q-08)
correlation_note: structurally correlated - the pair is only interesting because the two legs move in opposite directions

name: short week and international travel
hypothesis: Rest asymmetry (Thu-after-Sun, Monday follow, transmeridian fixtures) is systematically underpriced in totals late in the stretch
trigger_rule: days_since_prev_game < 4 or fixture flagged International (F-02: NE at DET Nov 15; SF at LA Sep 10)
sample_status: tiny (n=2 international fixtures in 2026 - likely never passes G-01)
correlation_note: rest effects are league-wide on a given slate,  so a same-slate parlay of two tired teams is correlated

name: backfield handoff after an IR placement
hypothesis: The lead back's IR move transfers volume to a backup whose prop line lags 24-48 hours
trigger_rule: status of RB1 becomes IR/OUT between Tuesday and Friday filings
correlation_note: prop set within one backfield is strongly correlated by construction (share sums to 1)

name: pace vs market total
hypothesis: Our verified per-play volume (dropbacks = pass att + sacks, plus rush att) times league efficiency predicts totals better than points-per-game recency
trigger_rule: model total - market total exceeds the abstain threshold from S-25
correlation_note: low correlation with single-game prop bets except through game script

name: inactive-list window
hypothesis: Between the 90-minute inactive list and kickoff, prop repricing is uneven: correlated props move before uncorrelated ones
trigger_rule: compare our pre-inactive model price with post-inactive market price
correlation_note: operational - correlation with the same player's other props

name: lineup-adjusted defensive deficiency
hypothesis: Defence-side deficiency (backup CB/S paired together) is worth more in the second half than the first because coverage shells are schematic
trigger_rule: >= 2 DBs out AND the team is projected within 3 points
correlation_note: correlated with the full-game opponent total (never parlay both)

name: referee crew
hypothesis: Crew tendencies are either fully priced or not exploitable; test it once, then kill it
trigger_rule: penalty-rate differential of the assigned crew
inputs_required: crew assignments (SRC-013 style official page not yet read)

name: correlated game stack
hypothesis: A same-game stack (team-total over + QB passing over) is only +EV if the joint probability exceeds the book's correlation-adjusted price; most offered stacks are under-priced at high totals
trigger_rule: P(joint) from simulation - implied parlay prob > vig threshold
correlation_note: this strategy IS a correlation trade - its variance estimate must use the covariance, not independence

name: anti-stack (uncorrelated legs across unrelated games)
hypothesis: Diversification across independent games is the only way a parlay can reduce variance; correlation ~0 by construction
trigger_rule: legs from different games, all > 55% model probability, covariance-adjusted price check
correlation_note: measured correlation between legs should be indistinguishable from 0 - that is the gate

name: prop-combo both-ways on a depleted backfield
hypothesis: When one RB is out, the RB1 carry over + team total under can both be right; the market prices them as if they were mutually exclusive
trigger_rule: SIG-08 and SIG-03 fire on the same team
correlation_note: negative correlation is what makes this pair cheap; must be measured, not asserted

name: model-vs-market residual on the close
hypothesis: Beating the close on our own numbers is the only durable evidence of skill; the strategy is the residual itself
trigger_rule: |model price - close| > abstain threshold, take the side the model disagrees with
correlation_note: by construction anti-correlated with the market's own information; correlation with other signals is what tells us whether we have one idea or five
